raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. Silver therefore shifts v2 transactions 6 hours later, which puts them outside opening hours and pushes evening sales onto the next date (the 36 spurious 2026-01-19 rows). All affected data is in January, when Chicago is on CST (UTC-6, no DST), so the fix subtracts a fixed 6 hours from v2 timestamps to bring them to the legacy local-time convention.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
